summary.plain: The first hint of neutrinos bouncing gently off germanium nuclei, seen with an array of eight ultra-pure germanium crystals, adding a third type of atom to the list where this effect has been caught.
summary.technical: First detection of CEvNS on natural germanium using the Ge-Mini array (eight 2.2 kg ICPC high-purity germanium detectors, 1.5 keVee threshold) operated at the SNS June-August 2023: an on-beam excess of 20.6(+7.1/-6.3) counts over 10.22 GWh*kg exposure, rejecting the no-CEvNS hypothesis at 3.9 sigma, in agreement with the Standard Model prediction within 2 sigma.

title: Evidence of Coherent Elastic Neutrino-Nucleus Scattering with COHERENT's Germanium Array
why_it_matters: Germanium is a widely used target in dark-matter and neutrinoless-double-beta-decay experiments; establishing its CEvNS response directly informs their neutrino-induced background and, longer term, low-threshold germanium technology for reactor and other compact CEvNS detectors.
